description: Screenshots and recordings of the production site used in the README. They show the business's photographs, logo and client work, which belong to LUXE Centro de Belleza and the people depicted. They are NOT covered by the MIT License.

authorization.scope: Publication of the files listed below in this public GitHub repository and its documentation
authorization.note: Set status to "approved" only with written permission from the business (and, for identifiable clients, their consent). Until then showcase/production/ stays git-ignored and `npm run verify:publication` fails.
